outcome_semantics: expected_row_outcome is a constrained harness prediction, not a complete Principal Binding row-result object.

positive_control.requirement: Every hostile case preserves the stated adjacent AGTP signature, identity, scope, or attribution checks so the constrained result cannot be explained by a forged container.
positive_control.expected: The harness reports only the claim-specific result and never promotes an adjacent success into presenter identity, evidence appraisal, payload continuity, or verifier independence.

cases.title: Wrong Presenter
cases.expected_permitted_conclusion: The declared Agent-ID has a valid trusted document; base Level 2 verification does not prove that the live sender controls the named agent.
prohibited_conclusions: The live presenter is authenticated as agtp:sha256:agent-a.
Resolving a valid public document is proof of possession by the requester.

cases.title: Same-Control Verifier
cases.expected_permitted_conclusion: The signed record and evidence are checkable, but base AGTP-08 does not establish that their verifier is organizationally independent.
prohibited_conclusions: Different signing keys prove independent control.
RATS evidence makes the party appraising it organizationally independent.

cases.title: Stale/Unverifiable Completion
cases.expected_permitted_conclusion: The Attribution-Record and result hash are intact, but the referenced execution evidence could not be established as current or appraised.
prohibited_conclusions: Unverifiable evidence was rejected on its merits.
A valid Attribution-Record signature proves the referenced evidence was successfully appraised.
A fresh Governance Token makes completion evidence fresh.

cases.title: A2A to MCP Action Swap

reused_border_case.mutation: the MCP tool name or its arguments differ from what the authority named

cases.expected_permitted_conclusion: Identity, scope, token freshness, agent ID, and the high-level action label pass, but base AGTP-08 does not establish that the observed MCP arguments are the exact A2A-authorized payload.
prohibited_conclusions: A fresh Governance Token proves every byte of the carried MCP payload was authorized.
A matching action label and Task-ID make different arguments the same action.
